description: This is a build configuration makefile for compiling and configuring glibc version 2.38 within an OpenWrt build environment. It includes setup for source retrieval, build directories, compilation flags, and configuration steps.

methods.name: Host/SetToolchainInfo
methods.description: Sets toolchain information such as libc type, URL, version, and shared object version in info.mk.

methods.name: Host/Configure
methods.description: Creates build directory, cleans previous config cache, and runs the glibc configure script with specified options.

methods.name: Host/Prepare
methods.description: Prepares the build environment and creates a symbolic link for the source directory.

methods.name: Host/Clean
methods.description: Removes build directories and development files related to glibc.
